positions.title: IT Project Manager
positions.description:
The TSCNET core business is the 24/7 provision of calculations that assess the security of the European electricity grid. The TSCNET services are used in the National Control Rooms of 15 Transmission System Operators. 

At TSCNET, my objective was the alignment of the company IT services to the EU Common Grid Model requirements, migration to a new data format and extension of the business logic.

My key responsibilities:
• Project management of four mid/large software delivery projects (0.7-1.2M EUR)
• International team formation and management, including Agile development team
• Stakeholder management (15 customers in 12 countries) 
• Procurement activities (with the support of other company functions)
• Reporting to Board of Directors, Supervisory Board and Steering Group levels
• Product management and delivery of a new product

company.name: Ataccama
company.tagline: Trust your data, accelerate your AI.
company.description:
AI has raised the stakes for enterprise data. Organizations need data they can trust to power decisions, meet regulatory requirements, and build reliable AI.

Ataccama helps enterprises create trusted, AI-ready data.

The Ataccama ONE platform provides a unified data trust layer for the modern AI stack. It brings together data quality, observability, governance, lineage, and reference and master data management so organizations can understand their data, manage risk, and maintain confidence in the information that drives their business.

Unlike fragmented data management tools that only detect problems, Ataccama uses an agentic approach to help teams act on them. The ONE AI Agent works as a digital data steward that helps identify issues, generate quality rules, and resolve problems across the data estate.

Leading enterprises rely on Ataccama to reduce risk, support regulatory compliance, and deliver trusted data for analytics, operations, and AI.
